name: Websites - Authorized - HR & Payroll [is]
description: Intent: Authorized HR, Payroll and Expenses domains — populate with sanctioned HR/payroll/expense platforms (e.g., workday.com, adp.com, rippling.com, bamboohr.com, expensify.com). Drives the Authorized split on D1050 (Internal HR) and is negated to define the Unauthorized HR surface on D1051. Exclusions: do not add personal financial accounts; do not add competitor HR platforms your org doesn't license; keep the list narrow to authoritative corporate HR systems.
